description: All the channels of one polyphonic signal put through six logic operations at once, in 2HP

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal whose channels are compared, each counted as high at 1V or more

outputs.text: Carries a high gate while every channel of the input is high
Carries a high gate while at least as many channels are high as the OR count on the menu
Carries a high gate while exactly as many channels are high as the XOR count on the menu
Carries a high gate unless every channel of the input is high
Carries a high gate while fewer channels are high than the OR count on the menu
Carries a high gate unless exactly the XOR count of channels is high

notes: the sixteen lights across the top show each channel, green for high and red for low
a small red mark beside the OR or XOR label shows that its count has been moved off 1; the number itself is only on the menu
menu: OR min count: 1 (default) to 16 — sets how many channels must be high for the OR output, and NOR follows the opposite of it
XOR exact count: 1 (default) to 16 — sets exactly how many channels must be high for the XOR output, and XNOR follows the opposite of it
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Gate-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming gate counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it
Gate-high output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while high, 10V unless you change it
Gate-low output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while low, 0V unless you change it

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
